events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling British debut album in history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe', an album that truly defined a generation. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for peace, love, and three days of music at Woodstock. An iconic moment in cultural history.

events.title: Elvis Presley: Would Have Been 91
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, and would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Elvis
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today. His legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll.

events.title: Tupac Shakur: Would Have Been 55
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, born June 16, 1971, was fatally shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. A voice that defined a generation and still resonates today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Would Have Been 84
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, born November 27, 1942, died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled guitar genius Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His influence on music remains immeasurable.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and timeless tracks still sound incredible.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders and an absolute icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today. Still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (UK Single) Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975, to promote the compilation album 'Shaved Fish'.

angles.name: Imagine UK Single Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a UK single. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the iPod. It completely revolutionised how we listen to music. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage, thrilling gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, legendary comedian and actor, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968, in the UK.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling 'White Album'. An incredible collection of diverse tracks.
